description: A mortgage lender's own 2025 HMDA filing, by name or LEI: records, loans originated and their dollar total, the loan-type and loan-purpose mix, and its largest states. Not a rating; no per-lender approval or denial rate is given.

query.description: part of the lender's legal name, e.g. "Wells Fargo", or its 20-character LEI

state.description: optional: only lenders with HMDA records for property in this state

name: lender_lookup
title: Mortgage lender profile (HMDA)
